# Templated

Templated is a platform that automates the generation of images and PDFs through a simple API, allowing users to design templates and render them multiple times with dynamic content.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/templated/.

## Actions

- **Clone Template**: Clone an existing template.
- **Create Template Render**: Create a document render from a template.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a template by its unique id.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Retrieve account information, including email, name, and timestamps.
- **List All Templates** (read-only): List all templates of a user.
- **List Template Renders** (read-only): List all renders of a specific template.
- **Retrieve Template** (read-only): Retrieve a single template by its unique id.
- **Retrieve Template Render** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific render by its id.
- **Add Tags to Template**: Append new tags to an existing template without overwriting existing tags.
- **Remove Template Tags**: Remove specific tags from a template.
- **Update Template Tags**: Overwrite all tags on a template.
